name: Union Quality Plastics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Union Quality Plastics Ltd manufactures polyethylene fabric.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
UQPL is an ISO 9001 and BIS-certified company engaged in the manufacturing of polyethylene fabric-based products. Its product range caters to packaging, shelter, waterproofing, and horticultural applications, serving diverse industrial and agricultural needs.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 42.4% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.04 Cr.
